name: browser__lightpanda_fallback_reason
notes: Chrome-fallback decision ladder (traced faithful copy of src/tools/browser_tool_helpers.c::browser__lightpanda_fallback_reason + LIVE twin tools/browser_tool.py::_lightpanda_fallback_reason). Inputs '<engine>|<command>|<result_json>'. Covers: non-lightpanda engine (incl. case-sensitivity), ineligible session commands, snapshot empty/short, screenshot with empty path, generic success no-op. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (inputs avoided, not hidden): (1) on success=false the port formats 'Lightpanda <cmd> failed (...)' while LIVE uses {command!r} -> "Lightpanda 'open' failed (...)" — quoting gap worth a port fix. (2) REAL PORT BUG (FAP): the port calls json_get_str(json_obj_get(data,"snapshot"), NULL, "") with arguments shifted (NULL as key), so nested data.snapshot/data.path lookups ALWAYS return '' — a healthy >=20-char snapshot is misclassified as too-short (port returns the fallback reason where LIVE returns None). Repro input: lightpanda|snapshot|{"success":true,"data":{"snapshot":"aaaaaaaaaa bbbbbbbbbb ccccccccc"}} — C=483d0bae0f637bb0 (fallback) vs PY=88a3d5286ea555ca (None). Fix: read the string node's value directly. Screenshot-with-existing-small-file branch also unexercised (needs a real file on both sides; argv-only inputs).
